description: This Java class defines a RecurrenceRule object used for scheduling recurring events, including methods for validation, calculating next occurrences, and handling recurrence rules with various frequency and interval options.

classes.name: RecurrenceRule
classes.description: Represents a recurrence rule for scheduling, with methods to initialize, validate, compute next occurrences, and manage recurrence constraints.

methods.name: RecurrenceRule
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RecurrenceRule object from a GenericValue entity.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes recurrence rule parameters and validates the rule.

methods.name: checkFreq
methods.description: Checks if the provided frequency string is valid.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end timestamp of the recurrence rule or -1 if none.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times the recurrence will run.

methods.name: getFrequencyName
methods.description: Returns the frequency name as a string.

methods.name: getFrequency
methods.description: Returns the frequency as an integer constant.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval of recurrence as a long.

methods.name: getIntervalInt
methods.description: Returns the interval as an integer.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next recurrence time based on current parameters.

methods.name: validCurrent
methods.description: Checks if the current recurrence is valid for a given check time.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a given date falls within the recurrence rules.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes this recurrence rule from persistent storage.

methods.name: getNextFreq
methods.description: Calculates the next frequency occurrence from a start time.

methods.name: validByRule
methods.description: Validates if a date complies with all byXXX rules.

methods.name: hasNumber
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with a number or sign.

methods.name: getDailyNumber
methods.description: Extracts the numeric part at the start of a string.

methods.name: getDailyString
methods.description: Extracts the non-numeric part of a string.

methods.name: getCalendarDay
methods.description: Converts day string abbreviations to Calendar day constants.

methods.name: primaryKey
methods.description: Returns the primary key string of the recurrence rule.

methods.name: makeRule
methods.description: Factory methods to create new RecurrenceRule instances with specified parameters.
